searchText: sorry if this is basics, but what determines the list of block proposers for the genesis epoch's slots? they are determined by the randomness in the genesis state - we always know the proposers one epoch ahead, the genesis epoch is no different https://beaconcha.in/blocks lists them, actually The initial entropy for the first two epochs of block proposers and attesters is provided by an eth1 block hash. <@!449019668296892420>, I see, thanks. <@!361447803194441738> isn't it only one epoch that we already know? Yeah one epoch for block proposers, two epochs for attestation duties.
